adapter_warnings: Model 04 is a conditional parameterised estimate for one calibrated decomposition pathway; it does not independently detect decomposition.
decomposition_overpotential_V must use the calibrated reaction-driving sign/reference convention and must not be substituted with terminal cell voltage.
Reaction heat is signed; positive indicates heat release and negative indicates heat absorption. Check the baseline heat ledger before aggregation.

model_output.kinetic_model: first-order electrolyte consumption with Arrhenius and calibrated potential acceleration
model_output.heat_interpretation: Positive reaction heat means heat release; negative means heat absorption.
model_output.interpretation: Conditional estimate for the specified calibrated decomposition pathway; not an independently detected electrolyte-decomposition event.
required_validation: Identify the specific decomposition pathway and define its overpotential sign/reference convention.
Calibrate rate_constant_ref_s, activation_energy_J_mol and transfer_coefficient for the target cell and pathway.
Validate electron_number and reaction_enthalpy_J_mol against reaction stoichiometry and calorimetry.
Validate electrolyte volume and initial concentration for the actual cell.
limitations: A single lumped pathway cannot represent the full coupled electrolyte, SEI and CEI reaction network.
The estimated electron-equivalent charge is pathway-specific and is not automatically equal to measured capacity fade.
The model does not predict gas composition, gas pressure, swelling or local depletion.
Temperature and overpotential inputs must be valid, synchronised and traceable.
Do not add reaction heat to baseline heat unless the baseline model excludes this parasitic reaction.

note: Native Model 04 payload passed unchanged. Estimates are conditional on the specified calibrated reaction pathway, kinetic parameters and overpotential convention.
